headline.text: L3 ML4 was down *3 hours* on a laser printer fault — cleared at 16:11 after extended troubleshooting.

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 ran almonds but the mini temper had multiple faults starting at 05:54 — pump, conveyor, and a leak — partially fixed by 06:48 but still needs ATP. S3 melting tank AD1 faulted out at 18:36 with no resolution. S4 struggled all shift with Hershey caramel spec vs. equipment mismatch.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had a 90-minute printer jam (13:27-13:44) and a 75-minute chocolate jam at the flow wrap (05:50-07:15), both cleared. FFS bucket 3 went down at 22:03 and is still out; blow-offs spiked overnight on pitch errors and false foreign-object rejects. Feeder target was set wrong at 07:09, causing low weights.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 lost 3 hours to a laser code printer that kept faulting (13:30-16:11). ML1 replaced the C6 belt overnight, back up at 04:18, but the belt went off-track again at 05:47. Truffle enrober wire belt failed at 22:28, found further damage after first repair, finally cleared at 05:18. ML4 end spiral conveyor stopped at 07:03 as the window closed.

notes.text: Almonds arrived at 01:04 for the S2 Hershey run.
SMETA auditor arrived unannounced at 09:36 and conducted floor tours and employee interviews through first shift.

resolved.title: ML2 chocolate jam at flow wrap
resolved.summary: Bars jammed at the flow wrap; maintenance tightened the chain but it jammed again after 15 bars; chocolate under the belt identified as the root cause.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:15 — "Line star running up" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 printer fault
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 13:27 when the flow-wrap printer faulted out; operators cleared and restarted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:44 — "Line star running up" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 Best If Used By date printing failures
resolved.summary: Some bars had no date printed, others blurred; affected product removed for rework and final cases inspected.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:47 — "Running line; the batch printing is correct" (Marlenis Fernandez).

resolved.title: ML4 laser code printer for caddies
resolved.summary: Laser printer skipped codes on caddies all shift, creating accumulation; maintenance worked multiple faults; line paused at 14:04 to avoid handing off backlog to second shift.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:11 — "Line 4 trigger sensor for coder is fixed and running again" (Shane Olsen). Line confirmed up at 16:11 by Shane.

resolved.title: Truffle enrober wire belt damaged
resolved.summary: Wire belt failed at 22:28; maintenance replaced it but found further damage at 04:33; bottomer also repaired and depositing resumed on time.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:18 — "Bottomer has been repaired will be depositing on time at 5:50 AM for an on time start up" (Alan Greer).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt replacement
resolved.summary: C6 belt failed and needed replacement; maintenance swapped the belt and performed ATP before restarting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:18 — "C6 belt up ml1 is up and running" (Imperial).

resolved.title: Cute Cavanna silver showing on flow wrap
resolved.summary: Too much silver foil visible inside and eventually outside the flow wrap; west side guide rail was out of place.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:33 — "west side guide rail was out of place. it's fixed now and the team is going to start back up" (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 1 guide rail failure
resolved.summary: A piece fell off from depositor 1; the green guide rail behind the depositor came loose.

resolved.title: ML4 gondola entrance jam
resolved.summary: Line stopped for a jam at the gondola entrance; operators cleared and restarted.

resolved.title: ML4 top conveyor belt jam
resolved.summary: Jam at the top conveyor belt; operators cleared and adjusted guide rails to prevent recurrence.

needs_attention.title: S2 mini temper multiple faults
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate won't flow properly from the mini temper; return conveyor 2 faulted, stirrer/pump faulted, and a leak appeared above the temper unit.
needs_attention.status: Leak tightened at 06:48, return belt 2 working as of 06:32, but C11 still needs visual check and ATP testing as of 07:04.

needs_attention.title: S3 melting tank AD1 faulting
needs_attention.summary: Melting tank AD1 faults out when switched to manual mode.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 18:36; no resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS bucket 3 down
needs_attention.summary: Buckets 3 and 4 stopped at end of second shift; bucket 4 restarted but bucket 3 is still down.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance reached out at 22:03; no update by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS excessive blow-offs on scale and X-ray
needs_attention.summary: Steady pitch-error blow-offs on the overweight side and QA rejects for foreign objects that clear when re-tested; tracking counts to determine if maintenance needed.
needs_attention.status: As of 01:48, still seeing steady pitch errors and surprising QA false rejects.

needs_attention.title: FFS low weights, feeder target incorrect
needs_attention.summary: Seeing many low weights; found the feeder target was set to 155.0g instead of product target weight.
needs_attention.status: Cy making adjustments and calibrating checkweigher scale as of 07:09.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C6 belt off-track recurrence
needs_attention.summary: C6 belt went off-track again at 05:47, less than 90 minutes after the overnight replacement; moves to west side.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 07:03; sensor replaced at 06:39; operators noted dirty rollers contributing to tracking issues.

needs_attention.title: ML4 end spiral conveyor stopped
needs_attention.summary: End spiral conveyor stopped at the close of the window; maintenance on-site.
